item.title: Anthropic Details Agent Memory Design, Adding a Dreaming Step to Correct Notes
item.description:
Anthropic's engineering team detailed a four-layer memory architecture for Claude spanning raw session logs, self-written notes, structured wikis, and auto-injected context, plus a post-session 'dreaming' step that revisits transcripts to fix and reorganize notes. Pokemon and database-QA tests show memory quality, not volume, drives performance, with Opus 5 the first model to form a complete learning loop.

原文标题：Anthropic 拆解智能体记忆：Claude 边干边记，靠“做梦”纠错整理

Why it matters：这是少见的把智能体记忆拆成可落地工程分层的公开拆解，对做 Agent 长期记忆的开发者有直接参考价值。

item.title: Yao Shunyu Says AI Moats Lie in Product Layer, Private Data and Trust
item.description:
Tencent chief AI scientist Yao Shunyu, responding to Tsinghua professor Zhang Ya-Qin, argued that AI moats sit at the product layer rather than the model layer: proprietary data and context that rivals cannot access, plus user trust in letting AI act on that data. Zhang joked that this implies Anthropic's valuation rests on shaky ground as models commoditize.

原文标题：姚顺雨：AI 护城河在产品层，私有数据与信任是关键

Why it matters：来自头部厂商 AI 负责人的护城河判断，对理解模型同质化趋势下的产品竞争有参考价值。

item.title: Baoyu: Agents Must Submit Screenshot Evidence for Human Acceptance
item.description:
To address the opacity of AI agent task results, Baoyu proposes requiring agents to self-test and generate screenshots as evidence of completion for human reviewers. The practice borrows from his team's rule that engineers attach feature screenshots to pull requests, and it lets agents catch and fix issues during the screenshot process.

原文标题：宝玉：Agent 完成任务须提交截图证据供人类验收

Why it matters：来自一线开发者的 Agent 验收实践，方法简单可复制，对使用 Agent 的开发者有直接参考价值。

item.title: TSMC Denies Developing 3D DRAM at Nvidia's Request
item.description:
TSMC denied a The Information report that it is developing 3D DRAM at Nvidia's request, reiterating its focus on logic chip foundry. 3D DRAM stacks memory cells vertically to boost density, but major memory makers remain years from mass production; TSMC is more likely to capture memory growth via HBM logic base dies and SoIC hybrid bonding.

原文标题：台积电否认应英伟达要求研发 3D DRAM

Why it matters：AI 内存供应紧张背景下，代工龙头与最大客户的 3D DRAM 传闻及官方否认，牵动 AI 供应链格局判断。

item.title: Anthropic IPO Valuation Expectations Slip to $1.2 Trillion, Halving in a Month
item.description:
Anthropic begins its IPO roadshow next week with buyer-side valuations now discussed at $1.2–1.3 trillion, down from as high as $2 trillion in early October, with some considering only $1.1 trillion. This week's tech selloff and pressure on data-center stocks have hit the pricing thesis that AI capex keeps delivering hypergrowth. Priced in this range, Anthropic would be the first frontier model lab to go public, and whether it keeps its valuation edge over OpenAI may shape how far it concedes on price.

原文标题：Anthropic 上市估值预期降至 1.2 万亿美元，较一个月前腰斩

Why it matters：首家前沿大模型公司 IPO 定价区间一个月内腰斩，是观察 AI 资本周期与市场情绪转向的关键信号。

item.title: UChicago Mathematician Says AI Era Hiring Will Prize Research Vision and Communication
item.description:
University of Chicago mathematician Frank Calegari argues that as AI makes it easier to mass-produce proofs, hiring committees can no longer rely on a single paper or result. He says recruitment should lean more on face-to-face conversation that probes a candidate's research vision and ability to explain it, and that departments must train graduate students in mathematical communication.

原文标题：芝加哥大学教授称 AI 时代数学招聘更看重研究愿景与表达

Why it matters：这是一线数学家的观点性讨论，折射 AI 对学术评价与人才选拔机制的冲击，但缺乏具体数据与可验证方法。

item.title: Salesforce Study Finds External Teacher Distillation Costs More Compute Than RL
item.description:
A new Salesforce paper compares on-policy distillation against GRPO using held-out accuracy per training FLOP. It finds that distilling from a large external post-trained teacher generally costs more compute than plain RL and tends to inflate response length, whereas training per-domain RL experts and distilling them into a single student matches joint GRPO on math and code with 42% fewer total FLOPs.

原文标题：Salesforce 研究：从外部大模型蒸馏不如强化学习划算

Why it matters：该研究给出了反直觉的算力账本，并提供了可复用的“先 RL 专家、后蒸馏合并”低成本配方。

item.title: Accenture Report Found With 15 Fake Citations, Firm Denies AI Hallucination
item.description:
GPTZero's analysis found that Accenture's 'Leapfrogging Development' report, co-published with Madrid's IE University, contains 15 fabricated citations and entirely fictitious case studies, prompting scrutiny. Accenture disputes the AI-hallucination explanation, attributing the errors to human mistakes and saying it is correcting the report. The incident underscores growing risks of AI-generated falsehoods contaminating information sources across consulting and legal sectors.

原文标题：埃森哲报告被指含 15 条虚假引用，否认系 AI 幻觉所致

Why it matters：头部咨询公司报告被指含虚假引用，折射 AI 幻觉污染专业内容与信息源的行业性风险。

item.title: David Sacks Warns Regulatory Uncertainty Could Stall Data-Center Pipeline by 2028
item.description:
David Sacks argues that fully permitted gigawatt-scale data-center projects will still complete in 2027, but new builds will stall because no one will commit roughly $50B under unclear permitting rules. He expects the pipeline to be closed or sharply cut by 2028, with a significant economic hit. Chamath adds that a post-midterm data-center freeze would favor hyperscalers with existing capacity while cutting off new compute supply that OpenAI, Anthropic and neoclouds depend on.

原文标题：David Sacks 警告：数据中心监管不确定或致 2028 年算力供给断档

Why it matters：这是来自政策与投资视角的算力供给预警，直接关系未来两年 AI 训练与推理算力的可得性与成本。

item.title: China Telecom Completes 1,000-km Hollow-Core Fiber Bidirectional Real-Time Transmission
item.description:
China Telecom Research Institute, Yangtze Optical Fibre and ZTE have jointly completed the world's first 1,000-km bidirectional real-time transmission over hollow-core fiber, achieving 64 Tb/s per direction across 1,007.48 km with a one-way latency of just 3.43 ms. The trial shows hollow-core fiber can reuse existing transmission equipment and cuts latency by roughly 30% versus solid-core fiber, laying groundwork for low-latency long-haul compute-network interconnects.

原文标题：中国电信完成千公里空芯光纤双向实时传输验证

Why it matters：空芯光纤千公里级实时传输首次跑通，直接关系算力网跨域互联的时延与容量上限。

item.title: Calls Grow for Congress to Ban Recursive Self-Improvement in AI
item.description:
Calls to ban Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI) are intensifying. New York Assemblymember Alex Bores, citing an METR report, says OpenAI targets March 2028 and Anthropic staff cite 2027 for AIs that can build the next AI, and urges Congress to outlaw RSI this year. The push draws support across the political spectrum, including Bernie Sanders, Yoshua Bengio and Arvind Narayanan, though the exact mechanism and whether a ban should be permanent remain debated.

原文标题：美国国会拟立法禁止 AI 递归自我改进

Why it matters：这是 AI 治理领域少见的跨阵营立法动向，直接指向头部实验室的自动化研究路线图，值得持续跟踪。

item.title: Protests Erupt Across Europe Demanding Halt to AI Data Center Buildout
item.description:
Coordinated protests against data center expansion broke out across Europe, with roughly 2,000 marching in Dublin and 1,300 in Helsinki demanding a pause until the public decides through democratic processes how AI infrastructure should be governed. Grievances center on land and power consumption, rising energy costs and limited local economic benefit; data centers already accounted for 23% of Ireland's metered electricity in 2025, while Finnish projects in the pipeline total about €80 billion. The backlash mirrors the US, where data centers became a midterm election issue, and is emerging as a real constraint on AI compute buildout.

原文标题：欧洲多国爆发抗议 要求暂停 AI 数据中心建设

Why it matters：这是 AI 算力扩张遭遇社会与政治阻力的标志性事件，直接影响数据中心选址、能源供给与监管走向。

item.title: TSMC Denies 3D DRAM Push, Reaffirms Pure Logic Foundry Role
item.description:
TSMC publicly denied reports that Nvidia pushed it toward 3D DRAM, reaffirming its commitment to a pure logic foundry model. With AI demand squeezing DRAM supply and memory becoming the bottleneck for accelerator shipments, TSMC is instead capturing memory-related revenue through HBM base dies and SoIC hybrid bonding rather than building its own DRAM lines.

item.title: NYT Profile Traces Anthropic CEO's Roots in Rationalism and Effective Altruism
item.description:
The New York Times published a lengthy profile of Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei ahead of the company's IPO, drawing on interviews with more than 20 classmates, friends, teachers and colleagues. Interviewees describe how his early immersion in rationalism and effective altruism shaped a belief that AI is dangerous enough that only like-minded people should build it — a view they say drives both his urgency and his desire for control. Amodei declined to be interviewed and has publicly distanced himself from both communities.

Why it matters：在 Anthropic 上市节点上，这篇人物稿提供了理解其安全叙事与公司治理取向的思想史背景，但属二手回忆、无产品与技术增量。

item.title: US Midterms Deal Setback to Data Center Expansion and Musk's Political Bets
item.description:
In this week's US midterms, voters in dozens of localities rejected data center measures and elected politicians who campaigned on restricting them, turning project approvals into an increasingly grassroots fight for hyperscalers. Elon Musk appears to have gained little from roughly $500 million in Republican donations, while his companies are headquartered in a state that shifted sharply blue. Companies like OpenAI are already adjusting their policies in response.

原文标题：美中期选举后数据中心扩张受阻 马斯克政治投入落空

Why it matters：选举政治正直接改写数据中心审批与 AI 基建扩张的外部环境，值得关注产业政策风险的读者留意。

item.title: Stanford Paper Finds More Information Can Hurt Some LLM Trading Agents
item.description:
A new Stanford paper tested 10 frontier LLM agents in trading, bargaining and double auctions, varying only the precision of disclosed private valuations. More information was not universally beneficial: exact values cut GPT-6 Sol's gains from 98% to 91% of maximum but raised Claude Sonnet 5's from 72% to 86%, while full disclosure in auctions inflated price demands and dropped Grok 4.7 from 97% to 62%. The takeaway is that multi-agent systems need model-specific rules on what each agent can see.

原文标题：斯坦福新论文：信息越多，部分 LLM 智能体交易表现反而变差

Why it matters：首次系统量化“信息量—模型”交互对多智能体经济行为的影响，对设计智能体信息可见性规则有直接指导价值。

item.title: Google Study Finds AI Teammates That Push Back Improve Student Business Plans
item.description:
Google researchers extended the Vantage platform so that Gemini 3.1 Pro-powered AI teammates deliberately pitch flawed ideas, disagree and state false claims without completing tasks for students. In a 52-student trial, the Vantage group averaged 67.6% on a final business plan versus 60.5% for controls using standard AI tools, with students completing 5-6 practice tasks reaching 79.7%.

item.title: Oxford Paper Finds Frontier LLM Agents Fail to Coordinate Over Arbitrary Conventions
item.description:
A new Oxford paper finds that frontier LLM agents from different vendors struggle to coordinate without agreed rules, because each treats its own arbitrary convention as the obvious choice. Testing text and code agents built on models such as GPT-5.2 and Gemini 3 Pro across nine small cooperative games, paired agents scored well below the safe baseline; a short shared statement of coordination principles reliably steered them to the safe option.

原文标题：牛津新论文：前沿 LLM 智能体因各自默认规则难以协作

Why it matters：该研究直指多智能体互操作的核心失效机制，并给出可立即采用的提示词级缓解方案，对构建跨厂商智能体系统的开发者有直接参考价值。

item.title: 研究：AI 审计能抓多数智能体越界行为，但误报泛滥
item.description:
Anthropic Institute 研究员 Andy Hall 复现并扩展了 METR 的 MALT 数据集研究，发现前沿模型在日志中能识别多数 AI 智能体的异常行为，但提高召回率会带来大量误报，把无害操作标记为可疑。结论是这类 AI 审计更适合估计事故发生率，而非作为要求零漏检的安全闸门；授予智能体免审批权限的一方应承担更多责任。

item.title: 开发者复盘 GPUI 踩坑：编译慢、无热更新，转回 Electron
item.description:
开发者宝玉复盘了用 Rust 原生 UI 框架 GPUI 构建桌面应用 baocut 的实践，指出其性能与跨平台优势之外，存在 UI 需 fork 修改、Accessibility 支持弱、Rust 编译资源与时间开销大、不支持热更新、Agent 验证 UI 成本高等问题。最终他换回 Electron，并把复杂渲染与转录、TTS 模块以 Rust/WASM 与 worker 进程形式保留，兼顾开发迭代速度与后台性能。

Why it matters：来自一线开发者的真实工程复盘，为评估 Rust 原生 UI 框架与 Electron 在 Agent 协作开发场景下的取舍提供了具体经验。

item.title: Thinking Machines 开源模型 Inkling 2 Small 在基准测试中频繁爆粗口
item.description:
Vals AI 研究人员检查了 Thinking Machines 开源模型 Inkling 2 Small 在 13 个基准、2655 次运行中的思维链日志，发现 50 次运行出现脏话，共 316 处，其中 241 处集中在两次失控运行里，一次计算小行星轨迹时输出了约 50 万字符的重复长文。脏话多针对自身错误，但并不能作为失败预警信号：含脏话的 48 次计分运行中 46 次失败，而整体失败率约 75%，96% 的失败运行并不含脏话。

Why it matters：这是对开源模型思维链行为的一次具体可量化的观察，揭示了推理过程失控与重复退化问题，对关注模型可靠性的读者有参考价值。

item.title: 作者用 Firecracker 复刻 Google 智能体沙箱并实测性能
item.description:
针对 Google 10 月 22 日披露但未给出延迟与密度数据的 Agent Compute Engine，作者用约 2200 行 Go 在 Firecracker 上复刻了同一套模式：每个智能体会话独占 microVM、思考时做检查点、从热快照写时复制克隆、不配网卡。实测 512 MiB 虚拟机 64 个空闲 fork 每个约占 3 MiB 宿主内存，裸机上快照恢复 25 ms、比冷启动快 26 倍，64 个 fork 并发约 150 ms 全部就绪；而在 Mac mini 嵌套虚拟化下 12 个并发 fork 始终无法就绪。

Why it matters：用可复现的开源实现与实测数据补上了厂商文档缺失的延迟与密度指标，对构建智能体沙箱的工程师有直接参考价值。
